text:
morgan: quick follow-up from the postmortem — proposing a small "circuit-breaker" playbook for phased releases that auto-trips on X% error or latency regression. want owners + timeline.

alex: love this. can we make it opt-in per-service? some infra teams rely on manual rollbacks for sensitive flows.

morgan: yes, opt-in. default policy for new routes = enabled with conservative thresholds. owners still get paged before full rollback.

jamie: adding a suggested policy snippet here — we can wire into feature-flag service and rollout controller.

jamie:
```
policy:
  name: circuit-breaker-v1
  thresholds:
    error_rate: 0.05 # 5% sustained over 2m
    p95_latency_increase: 0.4 # 40% above baseline
  action:
    - reduce_traffic: 50% # gradual downshift
    - notify: oncall,owner
    - auto_rollback: true
  cooldown: 5m
```

morgan: exactly. main goals: limit blast radius (reduce traffic), notify owners/oncall, and eventually auto-rollback if no obvious fix in N minutes.

sre-oncall: need clarity on escalation — if auto_rollback=true do we still page? prefer page immediately + short grace window.

alex: agree. page immediately. auto_rollback kicks after 10m and only if rollbacks are supported for that runtime (some legacy jobs need additional steps).

morgan: action items I propose:
- morgan: draft playbook doc + sample policy and PR to rollout controller configs — due Thu 2026-03-26
- jamie: feature-flag integration hooks + unit tests — due Mon 2026-03-30
- alex: inventory of services where auto_rollback unsupported + migration plan — due Mon 2026-04-06
- sre-oncall: define paging cadence and oncall runbook updates — due Fri 2026-03-27
- ops: create a recurring alert to detect repeated rollbacks (pattern detection) — due Mon 2026-04-13

morgan: i'll create a tracking epic and add these as cards. owners pls ack.

jamie: ack — i'll also add a small e2e that simulates a p95 spike to ensure the traffic-shift path is exercised.

alex: ack. i'll start the service inventory today.

deploy-bot: deploy started by morgan for docs/circuit-breaker-playbook (sha: ab12c3)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded in staging — smoke test passed

sre-oncall: thought: add a manual "pause" flag so oncall can block auto-rollback during incident debugging window.

morgan: good call. include manual pause + a UI toggle and API endpoint. will add to PR checklist.

jamie: also recommending telemetry: tag requests during phased release so we can do targeted rollbacks per-user cohort if needed.

morgan: thanks team. i'll open the epic and ping ops/pm. weekly check-in on status in #eng-platform sync until closed. :thumbsup:
